name: Media Converter
tagline: Convert audio and video files, or YouTube videos, to MP4 or MP3.
description: Convert media files to MP4 or MP3 in your browser, or download a YouTube video as MP4 or MP3. Only use content you own or are authorized to use.

seo.title: YouTube to MP3 and MP4, Online Video and Audio Converter
seo.description: Free online media converter. Convert your video and audio files to MP4 or MP3 in your browser, or download YouTube videos as MP3 or MP4.

formats: YouTube: MP4 up to 1080p, or MP3
content.technical: Conversion runs in your browser with FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. For YouTube links, the OpenTools server uses yt-dlp to relay the original video and audio streams; your browser then converts the audio to MP3 or joins video and audio into an MP4 without re-encoding.
content.privacy: Your own files are processed locally and never uploaded. YouTube videos pass through the OpenTools server only while they download and are never stored.
instructions: Choose a file, paste a direct link to a media file, or paste a YouTube link and click Find video.
Pick MP3 (audio) or MP4 (video) and the quality or resolution.
Start the conversion, wait for it to finish, then download the result.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. Files you choose are converted in your browser with FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. Only the converter engine (about 32 MB) is downloaded, once, from a public CDN.

faq.question: Can I download YouTube videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose the YouTube source, paste a link and pick MP3 or MP4. The video must be public; private, members-only, age-restricted videos and live streams are not supported. Only download content you have the right to use, and respect YouTube’s Terms of Service.

faq.question: Why did a YouTube download fail?
faq.answer: YouTube sometimes blocks requests from servers for a while. Try again later, or pick a lower resolution if the video is long. Videos larger than 500 MB cannot be processed.

faq.question: Why does a direct link fail to load?
faq.answer: Many hosts do not allow other sites to read their files from the browser. Download the file and upload it here instead.

faq.question: Why is it slow, and is there a size limit?
faq.answer: Conversion uses your device and a single thread, so large videos take time. Files up to 500 MB are accepted.
